schema.uvChannelBasis: UV0 primary for car materials (no UV2 in any inspected car16/car6 material set: runs 41306343412/41510907196); tracks bind UV0 tiled with UV1 as the lightmap channel
schema.flipPolicy: stated per row; the QC's as-authored rule requires the flip-policy exception to be stated (done per row + per binding)

notes: orientationClass/defect/correction for undocumented bindings are RULE-DERIVED from the effective transform and tagged 'rule-derived' in evidence; documented findings carry their run/commit citations
density pxPerMetre = textureWidth / metresPerUv0, valid only when --assembly supplies metresPerUv0
track rows: density join fills uv0/uv1 metres-per-tile from TRACK_UV_DENSITY_ACTUAL.json where the texture matches
